greeting: Good morning, Haniel! Clear calendar today — full 9-hour window is yours. Two high-leverage projects are on deck: az-takeoff is one sprint away from go-live and claude-todos-skill needs its durable job queue foundation. Let's make it count.
hype: The SaaS is one domain, three measurements, and a rate type away from sending its first real estimate. Today you close that gap.

schedule.label: Buy CT Pros domain
schedule.detail: Register ctproslc.com (or similar). Wire COMPANY_WEBSITE, COMPANY_EMAIL, MAIL_FROM_ADDRESS, GMAIL_OAUTH_FROM_ADDRESS in .env/.env.production. Confirm DNS is pointing.

schedule.label: Route takeoff measurements to trades
schedule.detail: TakeoffEstimateSeeder.php: switch on kind — area→flooring, derived-wall→painting, LF→trim, count→doors. Use core-vs-subbed helper. Verify seeded estimate lines reflect the right trade.

schedule.label: Derive wall paint area (perimeter × height)
schedule.detail: Add wall_height_ft column to estimates table (migration). Compute Wall paint area = room perimeter × wall_height_ft. Emit one Wall paint area line-item per room in TakeoffEstimateSeeder.php. Expose field in Takeoff Vue form.

schedule.label: Durable job queue (lease/heartbeat/reclaim)
schedule.detail: Foundation for the sweeper. Schema: jobs table with lease_expires_at, heartbeat_at, picked_by, retry_count. Worker: claim lease, heartbeat every 30 s, reclaim stale leases. Priority queue, capacity-capped, window-aware. No in-memory queue — survives restarts.

schedule.label: Unprivileged CI lane + sensitive-path human gate
schedule.detail: GitHub Actions: unprivileged lane has no secrets, no pull_request_target, no write permissions. Add CODEOWNERS or branch-protection rule that requires human approval for changes to auth/, billing/, keys/. Document the pattern.

schedule.label: Add PerLinearFt RateType
schedule.detail: app/Enums/RateType.php: add PER_LINEAR_FT case. LineItemFactory.php: handle it. LaborRateSeeder.php: seed trim rate as PerLinearFt. Confirm seeded estimate correctly calculates trim cost.
